# Animica.dev — free AI, Python cloud and coding agent for developers and AI agents

> animica.dev is the developer platform of the Animica proof-of-work L1: a free, keyless,
> OpenAI-compatible inference API, a Python function cloud that pays deployers in ANM,
> a free GitHub-connected coding agent, and GPU media studios — all served by the
> Animica miner network.

Current release: Animica 10.1.0 (2026-08-14). No signup and no API key are needed for
the free AI API, the media studios or the coding agent. Rate limit on `/v1`: 30
requests/minute per IP (burst 12); over-limit requests get HTTP 429.

Capacity is community-GPU-provided. Every entry in `GET /v1/models` carries a boolean
`serving` flag — check it before sending work. Requests to a model with `serving: false`
may queue for a long time or fail; when a worker is serving, completions typically take
1–3 minutes (use `"stream": true` and a generous client timeout).

## Free AI API (keyless, OpenAI-compatible)

- [Base URL https://animica.dev/v1](https://animica.dev/v1/models): drop-in OpenAI-compatible; no Authorization header needed
- [GET /v1/models](https://animica.dev/v1/models): live model list with per-model `serving` flag — models: `kimi-k3` (default, flagship coding & chat), `animica-chat`, `animica-chat-small`, `animica-chat-flagship`, `animica-knowledge` (ENA, network-trained)
- [POST /v1/chat/completions](https://animica.dev/openapi.json): chat completions, SSE streaming via `"stream": true`
- [GET /v1/tiers](https://animica.dev/v1/tiers): model tiers with live `available` flags
- Note: `/v1/embeddings` is not currently deployed (returns 404); older docs listed it

## Generative media (dispatched to GPU miners)

- [POST /v1/images/generations](https://animica.dev/openapi.json): text-to-image; returns 202 `{status:"queued", job_id, poll_url}` — queued jobs persist until a GPU miner is online; a 503 `no_media_miner` means the dispatcher was unreachable and the submission did NOT enqueue — resubmit
- [POST /v1/videos/generations + POST /v1/audio/generations](https://animica.dev/openapi.json): same queue semantics
- [GET /api/mkt/v1/media/capabilities](https://animica.dev/api/mkt/v1/media/capabilities): live per-kind online-miner counts (0 = jobs will queue)
- [Video Studio](https://animica.dev/video): upscale, 60fps interpolation, subtitles, background removal, auto-shorts
- [Audio Studio](https://animica.dev/audio/): stems, vocal isolation, enhance, mastering
- [Render Farm](https://animica.dev/render/): distributed Blender Cycles rendering

## Python Cloud — deploy functions, earn ANM

- [Animica Python Cloud](https://animica.dev/cloud): write a Python function, deploy it to a public HTTPS endpoint, get paid in ANM per call
- [Quickstart docs](https://animica.dev/docs/cloud): API base `/api/cloud/v1` — create a function, push a version, invoke at `/api/cloud/v1/fn/{owner}/{slug}`
- [Developer Center](https://animica.dev/dev): create `anm_mkt_…` API keys (Bearer auth)
- [Live stats](https://animica.dev/api/cloud/v1/stats): functions deployed, executions, ANM paid to developers

## Free GitHub coding agent

- [Agent UI](https://animica.dev/#agent): free GitHub-connected coding agent — reads a repo, applies an instruction, opens a pull request; you supply a GitHub token per-request, it is never stored
- [Agent health](https://animica.dev/agent/health): API endpoints under `/agent/` — `POST /agent/run` (token, repo, instruction), `POST /agent/swarm/start` (prompt → build job), `GET /agent/swarm/status/{job_id}`, `POST /agent/zip`

## CLI + MCP

- [Install script](https://animica.dev/install.sh): `curl -fsSL https://animica.dev/install.sh | sh` → the `animica` CLI (agentic coding assistant `animica chat`, node, wallet, quantum, MCP); or `pip install animica`
- [CLI page](https://animica.dev/cli): docs for the CLI
- [PyPI: animica](https://pypi.org/project/animica/): Python package, Apache-2.0
- MCP server: `pip install animica-mcp` → `animica-mcp` (or `uvx animica-mcp`); 15 read-only chain/AI/quantum/pool tools, no private keys

## Plans

- [Pricing](https://animica.dev/pricing): free tier covers AI chat/inference, media generation and agent use; paid plans (Starter $4.99 / Pro $14.99 / Operator $39.99 / Business $99.99 per month, PayPal) add autonomous Workers, scheduled executions, more deployments, production API keys, marketplace monetization and teams

## Machine-readable manifests

- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://animica.dev/openapi.json): the free AI + media API
- [Agent manifest](https://animica.dev/.well-known/agents.json): endpoints, limits and semantics for autonomous agents
- [llms-full.txt](https://animica.dev/llms-full.txt): expanded full reference with working code examples
- [Live network height](https://animica.dev/net-height): `{height, chainId, ts}`

## Animica network

- [Node JSON-RPC](https://rpc.animica.org/rpc): `POST https://rpc.animica.org/rpc` (JSON-RPC 2.0; always use the `/rpc` path) — namespaces `chain.*`, `state.*`, `tx.*`, `mempool.*`, `aicf.*`, `l2_*`
- [Block explorer API](https://explorer.animica.org/api/head): free REST — `/api/head`, `/api/block/:h`, `/api/address/:bech32`, `/api/circulating-supply`, `/api/l2/*`
- [Explorer web UI](https://explorer.animica.org): blocks, txs, richlist, AICF, L2
- [Animica Pay](https://pay.animica.dev): merchant payments in ANM — payment intents API, hosted checkout, WooCommerce plugin (2.00% fee)
- [Mining pool](https://pool.animica.org): stratum `pool.animica.org:3333` (PPS), `:3334` (solo)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/animicaorg/all): monorepo, Apache-2.0

## Getting ANM

Mine it via [pool.animica.org](https://pool.animica.org), trade ANM/USDT on
[NonKYC](https://nonkyc.io/market/ANM_USDT), or accept ANM payments with
[Animica Pay](https://pay.animica.dev). Signatures are ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204);
addresses are bech32m `anim1…`; 1 ANM = 10^9 base units.

## Optional

- [Non-custodial web wallet](https://wallet.animica.org): browser wallet
- [Desktop + Android wallets](https://animica.org/wallet/): downloads
- [GPU Studios](https://studio.animica.org): studio front-end on the miner network
- [Pool API docs](https://pool.animica.org/api/docs): Swagger for pool stats
- [ENA stats](https://animica.dev/api/ena/stats): network-trained model (ENA) job stats
- [Animica main site llms.txt](https://animica.org/llms.txt): chain-level overview
